title: To the Ends of the Earth

request.style: English, male choir, organ, strings, timpani, deep reverberation, majestic, 90 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Gathered around him in the quiet hall
They asked about the time of the kingdom's call
He spoke of seasons only the Father knows
Times set apart by his own authority

[Chorus]
You will receive power when the Spirit comes
Witnesses in Jerusalem, Judea, Samaria
Carrying the light to the ends of the earth

[Verse]
As they watched in wonder he was lifted high
A cloud took him from their sight and memory
Two men in white robes stood beside them then
Speaking of the promise of his return

[Chorus]
You will receive power when the Spirit comes
Witnesses in Jerusalem, Judea, Samaria
Carrying the light to the ends of the earth

[Bridge]
Why do you stand here looking into the sky
He who has gone into heaven will return

[Outro]
Power from the Holy Spirit on you
To the ends of the earth
